_comment: Default parameters for human PSG, resolving five stages (WAKE, NREM1, NREM2, NREM3, REM). Differs from the rodent files in three ways: 30 s epochs as standard in human scoring; per-frequency z-scoring, so components are comparable across subjects; and three clustering steps rather than one, because a single night is short and the EMG alone does not separate wake reliably. Keys beginning with _ are comments and are ignored.

EEG._comment: 0.3-35 Hz spans delta through spindles and beta. 30 s epochs match AASM scoring.

EMG._comment: Set notch to 50 (Europe) or 60 (North America) if nyx.check_signals reports mains pickup; chin EMG picks it up readily.

steps._comment: No EMG threshold: a threshold above 1 puts every epoch into SLEEP, because EMG power is min-max scaled to [0, 1]. Wake is recovered by clustering in the next step instead. Raise nosignal_threshold to drop flat or disconnected stretches.
steps.name: no_emg_split

steps._comment: Wake vs sleep by clustering the whole recording on 2 PCs plus EMG power. elliptic fits the dense sleep bulk and calls the scattered remainder wake, which suits a night that is mostly sleep.
steps.name: wake_sleep

steps._comment: Optionally separate NREM1 out of what was called wake. Map both clusters to WAKE to skip this split for a recording where it does not look convincing.
steps.name: split_wake

steps._comment: Split sleep into the deeper stages. Four clusters for three stages is deliberate: NREM2 is broad and usually needs two. Add a refinement here to divide a stage by a component, e.g. NREM1 out of NREM2.
steps.name: split_sleep
